Academic Programs and Pathways

Degrees and Certificates

English

English

Studying literature can improve your reading and writing abilities, as well as boost your ability to think critically and communicate clearly. Companies and organizations in every field and across all sectors seek out employees with these skills. English offers three tracks to get you major ready for transfer: Composition and Literature, Creative Writing, and Technical Writing.

          Featured Faculty

          See English Faculty page

David López-Kopp

Program Co-Chair

David López-Kopp earned his BA in Sociology, emphasis in Gender Studies, from the State University of New York at Stony Brook, and his MA, emphasis in Composition Studies and Rhetoric, from Northern Arizona University. Additionally, he holds an advanced teaching certification in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL). 

                See David Lopez-Kopp's full bio

Hyesu Park

Program Co-Chair

Hyesu Park was born and raised in South Korea and earned her PhD in English at Ohio State University. Her primary research interests include Asian American and American literatures, narrative theory, Korean literature in translation, Korean popular culture, and media studies. 

                See Hyesu Park's full bio
